title: Prepare reproducible six-language release qualification without publishing or altering protocol behavior
description: Prepare reproducible six-language release qualification without publishing or altering protocol behavior
acceptance_criteria: All six existing hosted lanes test and build non-publishing qualification artifacts; Artifact checks fail on missing or malformed expected contents; Release provenance verification rejects missing evidence and empty or invalid ranges; The release checklist separates local hosted author-reported and unrun evidence and preserves package identities destinations and versions; No protocol crypto session or publishing behavior changes
